reviews.name: lexxpetunia
reviews.body: Bought these as another brand were out of stock but I’m a convert. I’ve been using them twice a day morning/night and really noticed a difference in texture and fullness of my face.

reviews.name: Kirsty
reviews.body: I like the feeling of these but they weren't as good as some other pdrn pads out there. The box also leaked quite badly and didn't travel well.

reviews.name: Jennie
reviews.body: Ideal sized pads for those who don’t want to commit to a full on sheet mask.

reviews.name: Looby
reviews.body: Easy to use and skin feels clean and supple after use

reviews.name: RachelW
reviews.body: I brought these on a whim as i was curious and i absolutely love them. You can swipe over your face or apply as a spot mask to various areas i apply to my neck and particularly dry spot on head and they have worked really well especially if used daily. Will be repurchasing

reviews.name: Dani
reviews.body: Unsure yet on the actual effect of these pads but they are very nice texture wise and easy to use

reviews.name: Vics77
reviews.body: I’m enjoying using these. I’m noticing more fine lines and wrinkles and found these on here. I feel that they are very hydrating and not overly adding to my current combination menopausal skin.

reviews.name: Selene
reviews.body: Love, that it has smaller economical footsteps, like the other  individual  masks. And i like the results too.

reviews.name: Kim
reviews.body: Really good. Leaves your skin feeling very hydrated

reviews.name: Jo D
reviews.body: I tried these as I’ve got ageing skin and wanted something to give it a moisture boost. These are fab and much better than the glow recipe similar pads. Leave my skin bouncy and soft but not tacky. Great for makeup prep!
